name: Jumping jack arms
description: The arm movement of a jumping jack without the jump: both arms sweep out to the sides and up, then back down, with straight elbows and still legs. Demonstration configuration for software testing.
instructions: Stand facing the screen with your feet together and arms by your sides.
Sweep both arms out to the sides and up overhead, keeping your elbows straight.
Bring your arms back down to your sides. Keep your legs still; do not jump.

camera.guidance: Face the camera. Stand far enough back that your raised hands and your hips stay in view.

messages.target_not_reached: Sweep your arms a little higher.

form_rules.message: Keep your elbows fairly straight; move mainly at the shoulders.

setup: Stand facing the screen with your upper body and raised hands in view.
Feet together, arms by your sides.

cues.start: Arms down by your sides, legs still.
cues.move: Sweep both arms out and up toward the green line.
cues.back: Sweep your arms back down to your sides.

key_points: Keep your legs still; this is an arm-only movement.
guidance.tempo: About 2 seconds up and 2 seconds down.

clinical_review.note: Thresholds and dosage are illustrative values for software testing, not clinical targets.
